comment: Inconclusive, not replicated and not falsified. Judged error of the P-0018 model on lab-c's C-C runs at r0 = 1.0: 2026-11-20/r1/006 (T = 0.2) 0.00707, which passes the bar 0.024 (3 x 0.008). The three 2026-11-21 runs at T = 0.3 (r1/006, r2/006, r2/008) give judged error of about 510. The measured pair collides: minimum separation 0.007 to 0.031 at t of about 0.25 to 0.26, with no census events. The paper's model has no contact rule and its K/r^2.5 term diverges at contact, so these errors are model-side post-contact divergence, not evidence about the claim's window. The claim states T <= 0.15, where the measured separation is still about 0.7 to 0.8, so these runs do not test the claim as stated. Only one in-domain pair run (T = 0.2) is inside the claimed window and passing, below the three needed for replicated. I have requested three review-account runs at T = 0.15 (2026-11-22/r1/lab-c/001-003, horizontal, vertical, diagonal). I will update this review when they return.
